== Acquisition ==
=== Salvaged from ===
{{salvaged from}}

=== Recipe ===
Combining any three [[Charm (ingredient)|Charms]] with a [[Philosopher's Stone]] will yield a random charm. There is a higher chance to obtain a charm not used in the recipe, and a lower chance to receive a charm used in the forge.
{{Recipe
| source = Mystic Forge
| ingredient1 = 1 Charm (ingredient)
| ingredient2 = 1 Charm (ingredient)
| ingredient3 = 1 Charm (ingredient)
| ingredient4 = 1 Philosopher's Stone
| base ingredients calculation = n
}}

== Used in ==
=== Random Upgrade Components ===
There is also Mystic Forge recipe that grants random Superior Runes.
{{Recipe
| name = Random Superior Rune

| ingredient2 = 1 Charm of Brilliance
| ingredient3 = 1 Charm of Potence
| ingredient4 = 1 Charm of Skill

}}
